additional_context: The 2025-01-13 OO HCP minutes recorded the 9-0-0 FHIR-47048 vote, the conclusion that URL can be represented in Endpoint.address, and the plan to coordinate this with moving Device.endpoint to an extension. FHIR-32565 and FHIR-48923 removed Device.endpoint and related communication elements from core Device, while FHIR-47326 created the FHIR Extension Pack device-endpoint extension. That extension exists as Reference(Endpoint), but the requested migrated Device.url comment is not present there.
